openings.claim: Keep surname dividers; record household discrepancies and update the behind-desk exception slip whenever books move.
openings.discriminator: Verified mappings and locations should reduce second searches; persistent burst-related delays favor congestion.
openings.probe: Clerk records address correctness, second searches, queue presence, preparation and reconciliation time.
openings.uncertainty: Bounded probe only; service-time maintenance, adequate claimant verification and benefit remain unproven.

openings.claim: Cart retrieval may outperform shelving; ten synthetic fast pickups challenge universal shelving superiority.
openings.discriminator: Comparable cohorts retain cart advantage; disappearance with volume or size favors sample selection.
openings.probe: Observe natural cart versus shelf pickups using timing paper; record volume and book size.
openings.uncertainty: Unmatched comparisons are inconclusive; capacity, correctness and routine retention remain unproven.

openings.claim: A private reader-to-position register and numbered shelf regions could replace surname-based retrieval.
openings.discriminator: Faster lookup for mismatched surnames despite correct locations distinguishes positional addressing from move updates.
openings.probe: Shadow paper/card lookups without moving books or changing handoffs; record mismatch, location accuracy and time; omit if preparation allowance exhausted.
openings.uncertainty: Operational replacement, identification reliability and affordable register maintenance remain unproven.

openings.claim: Keep an arrival batch stationary on the cart through evening to reduce location churn.
openings.discriminator: Matched fast pickups and fewer second searches support stability; equal accurate-shelving performance favors small-volume explanation.
openings.probe: Confirm capacity and return use before trial; measure complete pickup times and wrong-reader handoffs.
openings.uncertainty: Capacity, competing returns, scalability and benefit are unknown; slower matched batches or obstruction defeat it.

decision: Use bounded probes; effects are untested synthetic hypotheses. Only existing clerk hands off; identities stay behind desk; use two shelves and one return cart; total daily preparation <=10 clerk-minutes. Require claimant verification. Assess >=95% within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. Household-delay linkage, cart volume/size effects and interview representativeness remain unknown.
